scope_note: The official stenographic report of the Second Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR, volume III, as an image-only scan of two-page spreads. The sixteenth (morning) sitting of 7 December 1990 (contents, PDF p. 239; printed p. 134 on PDF p. 68) was read. The volume has no text layer; it was searched with a word spotter and the hits read from the page images, so other mentions may be missed. The scan is hosted by the non-official ISTNET / RSFSR-RF.RU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff.

ISBN 5-250-02191-3 (library card, PDF p. 240); an image-only scan of two-page spreads (241 PDF pages): PDF page n shows printed pp. 2n-2 (left) and 2n-1 (right).

It serves page-image scans of the printed stenographic reports of the RSFSR Congresses; its live HTTPS certificate does not verify from this environment, so each identity is a pre-cutoff raw Internet Archive capture (the base32 SHA-1 of the recorded bytes equals the capture's CDX digest).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

rows.text: At the sixteenth (morning) sitting of the Second (extraordinary) Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR (7 December 1990), a deputy who did not introduce himself announces: 'Членов блока ”Демократическая Россия” просьба собраться в два часа на балконе. Будет рассматриваться вопрос о выборах в совет представителей движения ”Демократическая Россия”.'
rows.locator: Sixteenth sitting: contents, PDF pp. 239-240 (sixteenth sitting printed pp. 71-136, seventeenth from p. 137); announcement, printed p. 134 (PDF p. 68, left page)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
